dogecoin.text: Elon Musk discussed Dogecoin efforts in an interview with Fox’s Bret Baier, emphasizing the importance of careful planning, saying, “We want to measure twice if not thrice and cut once.” He acknowledged that while mistakes are made,they are corrected quickly and the team moves on https://t.co/DwQHJQzcbo

The Wall Street Journal reports that Dogecoin’s $150 billion cuts had little impact on government spending, with federal expenditure under Trump surpassing that of 2024 under Biden. https://t.co/CCd7DlFDj6
